jobs_results.description:
INCORPORACIÓN EN JUNIO O AGOSTO❗❗

En Hubtalent tenemos una oportunidad profesional de Ingeniero de puesta en marcha Software, en una importante multinacional especializada en robótica y automatización, con sedes en los 5 continentes. ¡Más de 4.000 empleados a nivel mundial! 🌍

Se requiere una alta motivación multicultural e internacional.

No es una posición de developer, sino de Ingeniería, no programarás a nivel de máquina directamente.

¡Te incorporarás en un equipo con personas de todo el mundo y estarás en torno al 70% fuera de España, en proyectos de entre 1 y 6 semanas poniendo en marcha y configurando sistemas automatizados!

✅REQUISITOS:

Mínimo un B2 de inglés, aunque no es necesario certificación.

Carnet de conducir con 2 o más años de antigüedad.

💸Salario: Hasta 23K + Dietas + Remuneración por tiempo en el extranjero y horas extras (Total cercano a los 40K)

🏨Localización: Madrid, aunque después de un año podrás teletrabajar en tu ciudad el 30% del tiempo que estés... en España

👣 NEXT STEPS:

Apúntate en la oferta para conocer más detalles de la posición y de la empresa

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer Oracle APEX 100% Remoto
jobs_results.description:
Desde Ibertech nos encontramos en búsqueda de personas que quieran formar parte de un gran equipo y para ello buscamos un/una Software Engineer Oracle APEX:

Requisitos:
• Preferible más de 6 años de experiencia (o al menos 3 años mínimo):
• Experiencia de más de 6 años en desarrollo de aplicaciones a medida con alguna tecnología como Java, Javascript, base de datos Oracle, PL/SQL
• Experiencia de más de 3 años utilizando la plataforma Oracle APEX para desarrollo de aplicaciones, tiene que ser un referente en el uso de esta tecnología
• Conocimientos consolidados en diseño y arquitectura en desarrollo de aplicaciones utilizando base de datos Oracle (SQL, PLSQL, etc)
• Conocimientos consolidados en diseño y arquitectura en desarrollo de aplicaciones web (Javascript, HTML, CSS)
• Capaz de abordar desarrollos nuevos, migraciones o mantenimiento

Valorable:
• Valorable experiencia en Oracle Forms y Oracle Reports
• Valorable experiencia en Scrum y Agile, uso de Atlassian... JIRA

Características:
• Contrato indefinido
• Estable
• Modelo 100% Remoto, valorable también 1 o 2 días in situ en Madrid.
• Jornada completa
• Planes formativos
• Retribución flexible

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
ABOUT US:

TrustCloud is a global tech company with a state-of-the-art choreographer that orchestrates and vaults secure digital transactions. Our TrustCloud Platform helps corporations to secure online transactions worldwide.

Due to our company's growth, we are seeking highly productive, dynamic, hardworking, and effective Software Engineers who are capable of working in a team and committed to results and responsibilities.

RESPONSABILITIES:
• Systems design, programming, and software development using C#, .NET Core, and other relevant technologies.
• Designing and administering databases, including tasks such as implementation, modification, and optimization.
• Collaborating with Agile Methodologies, specifically SCRUM, to ensure efficient project management and delivery.

REQUIREMENTS:
• Relevant experience in systems design, programming, and software support.
• A minimum of 6 years of experience as a developer, with expertise in C#, .NET, etc.
• Familiarity with Agile... Methodologies, particularly SCRUM.
• Effective communication and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and make decisions within established guidelines.

DESIRABLE:
• Knowledge in WPF, Entity Framework, Bootstrap, Angular, Postman, etc.
• Proficiency in Transact-SQL, including stored procedures, views, cursors, etc.
• Familiarity with Microsoft Online tools such as Visual Studio, SharePoint, and Office 365.
• Construction and management of APIs.
• Experience with Team Foundation Server.
• Familiarity with Test Framework.
• Application and platform migration experience.

WHAT WE OFFER:
• Exciting and challenging projects with a strong focus on research and development.
• Opportunities for career development and growth.
• A pleasant and collaborative working environment, where you can thrive as part of a dedicated team.
• Competitive compensation package based on your professional background.
• Flexible work schedule to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
• Possibility of a hybrid work model, combining office and remote work

jobs_results.title: INGENIERO/A SOFTWARE
jobs_results.description:
Formando parte del departamento de I+D, la persona realizará tareas de desarrollo de firmware en lenguaje de programación C para microcontroladores, así como el seguimiento y evolución de proyectos en desarrollo.

La persona se integrará en un equipo de desarrollo software dinámico, poco jerarquizado, en el que pueda explotar sus cualidades y tener una evolución profesional continuada en un entorno de “Mass Production” electrónico.

El tipo de firmware a desarrollar es cercano al hardware de microcontrolador y requiere que la persona tenga conocimientos asentados de electrónica. Esto le permite alcanzar un conocimiento global de la aplicación, no solamente restringido al software.

Mas que experiencia en desarrollo software, se busca un perfil que pueda encajar en el equipo de software y evolucionar dentro del departamento.

Se ofrece sólida carrera dentro de un entorno internacional de I+D avanzado tecnológicamente y posibilidades de evolución profesional dentro del área de la... electrónica.

Funciones

Desarrollo de software para microcontroladores en aplicaciones de inducción profesional.

Diseño del sistema de control del equipo teniendo en cuenta las normas de seguridad pertinentes, desarrollo y testeo del mismo para su posterior producción en serie.

Mantenimiento y apoyo a fábrica durante la vida útil del producto.

Desarrollo de software para microcontroladores.

Requisitos:
• Inglés
• Programación C

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a de software C++ - Aviónica (Defensa)
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte de la experiencia Exceltic, una empresa con estrategia centrada en las personas?

¿Tienes inquietud por conocer el sector técnico y tecnológico?

¡Ésta es tu oportunidad!👇

Estamos en búsqueda activa de un/a Ingeniero/a de software para participar en el desarrollo de modelos de SW para la simulación en el proyecto más importante que se esta desarrollando a nivel europeo en defensa.

✅Tus funciones se centrarán en:
• Desarrollo de software orientado a objetos
• Desarrollo de modelos de SW para la simulación Simlab

🔎¿Qué buscamos?
• Ingeniería informática, industrial o telecomunicaciones
• Experiencia de al menos 2 años en programación orientada a objetos, preferiblemente C++. Linux, Windows, Visual C++
• Inglés alto
• Disponibilidad para viajar (1 vez cada tres meses viajes de una semana)

🙌Ofrecemos:

1. Posición estable.

2. Contrato indefinido.

3. Plan de retribución flexible (seguro médico, ticket transporte, restaurante y guardería).

4. Plan de... formación.

5. Horario flexible con posibilidad de teletrabajo (formato híbrido). 3 días en oficinas 2 días en remoto.

💫Vivir la experiencia Exceltic significa:
• Participar en proyectos punteros en donde puedas desarrollar tus habilidades.
• Percibir un salario competitivo en función de aportación.
• Disfrutar de un plan de retribución flexible.
• Equilibrar tu vida personal y profesional.
• Formar parte de un equipo en el que te sientas escuchado/a y en donde puedas aportar nuevas ideas.

💬Acerca de nosotros…

Somos una empresa de servicios de ingeniería y consultoría tecnológica. Desarrollamos nuestra actividad en distintos sectores (Ferroviario, Aeronáutico, Espacio, Defensa, Energía, Automoción, Industria, Tecnologías de la Información y Telecomunicaciones). También proporcionamos servicios de auditoría técnica y formación especializada.

A día de hoy contamos con una sólida cartera de clientes multinacionales en los distintos sectores y una de las ofertas más completas del mercado.

En la familia Exceltic Somos más de 500 miembros y contamos con oficinas en Madrid, Barcelona y Bilbao y con proyectos en los cinco continentes.

No lo dudes... ¡Únete a nuestro equipo

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Title: Software Engineer

Location: Barcelona

Experience: Mid Level

Job Function: Software Development

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Computer And Network Security

About The Position

Keyfactor is one of the world’s leading companies for Machine Identity, Certificate Lifecycle Management and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Solutions. We help security teams manage cryptography as critical infrastructure by simplifying PKI including Certificate Issuance, Certificate Life Cycle Management, and Secure Code Signing.

Skills

This position will work as a core member of our software development team in Barcelona Spain working on Keyfactor Signum, one of our Code Signing products. This position will have the opportunity to work on unique projects that will require strong problem solving skills and a willingness to learn new technologies. Some example projects might include:
• Helping the team migrate applications from .NET Framework to .NET Core
• Creating new features and... maintaining .NET Core applications for Windows, MacOs, and Linux
• Migrating .NET Core applications to run in containerized environments
• Helping the team create and maintain software build pipelines with tools like Jenkins and Artifactory

 The position is based in our Barcelona office and applicants must hold a valid Right to Work in Spain. 

 Responsibilities 
• Backend Software Development - Involves design and implementation of new features as well as maintenance and refactoring of existing features within the product code base. 
• Basic architecture participation – Participate in design meetings to learn and provide input  
• Participation in Agile ceremonies – Participate in Sprint Planning, Reviews, Retrospectives, and daily scrums 
• Team collaboration – Work closely with other team members to devise solutions to code and architectural challenges 
• Onboarding and mentoring – Participate in the onboarding and mentoring process of new employees and interns 
• Code reviews – Submit and participate in code reviews in order to ensure standards, and improve the overall team technical aptitude 

Skills And Qualifications 

Required Experience 
• Demonstrable professional experience in developing software applications as a team-member. 
• Strong problem solving skills with a willingness to learn new technologies
• .NET Experience:  Strong knowledge in both .Net Framework and .Net Core. 
• Experience with creating and maintaining containers for production software applications
• Experience working with and implementing REST APIs
• Experience working as part of an Agile team
• Version Control: Experience in version control using Git. 
• Fluency in English

 Preferred Experience
• Familiarity with Linux and MacOS based development
• Experience working with build pipelines using tools like Jenkins and Artifactory
• Understanding of best practices creating Docker files
• Experience with PKI is a plus.
• You hold a degree in Computer Science, SW Engineering, a related field, or have relevant equivalent experience.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience.

Culture, Career Opportunities And Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. A few initiatives that make our culture special include: 
• Comprehensive benefit coverage 
• Dedicated employee focused ambassadors via Key Contributor & Culture Committee 
• DIVERSE Commitment  
• Global Volunteer Day
• Flexible time off 
• Monthly Cross Functional meetings 
• Monthly Leadership Development meetings 
• Monthly All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings  
• Second Friday’s (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month) 
• The Keyfactor Alliance Program 
• Weekly Feedback Snapshot 

 Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount - We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core - We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates - The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility - We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect - Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen - Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.  

Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer.   

REASONABLE ACCOMODATION: Applicants with disabilities may contact a member of Keyfactor’s People team via people@keyfactor.com and/or telephone at 1.216.785.2990 to request and arrange for accommodations at any time.

Keyfactor Privacy Notice

jobs_results.title: Sr Advance Vision Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
All of us at EFI are relentlessly focused on just one thing: the growth and success of the print business. That’s why tens of millions of print professionals worldwide turn to EFI to fuel their success. Our 3,000+ worldwide team members prove our commitment to you every day by developing breakthrough technologies for the manufacturing of signage, packaging, textiles, ceramic tiles, and personalized documents, with a wide range of printers, inks, digital front ends that transforms and streamlines the entire production process, increasing your competitiveness and boosting productivity.

EFI is looking for a Sr. Advance Vision Software Engineering to join our hardware development team in our Castellon office. We are running exciting projects and we are growing. We are looking for an experienced professional who enjoy out of the box thinking.

You will be part of a dynamic high-visibility team working on new product initiatives close with the rest of the team, our colleagues, and... customers around the globe. You will be delivering intuitive and robust applications, easy to use by our customers and making a distinct difference from our competitors.

What Will You Do

Improve current Image quality by adding this technology.

Develop algorithms that could optimize the results.

Image processing and Analysis.

Analysis and verification of the image quality delivered in the products.

Software integration between image processing and press Software

This role might be a good fit if you if you bring:

Knowledge on software in general

Deep knowledge of C/C++ in embedded or ioT environments.

Good understanding of the use of STD in embedded.

Deep knowledge of Concurrency and real time processing

Deep knowledge of Image processing. OpenCV, Google vision, MS computer vision, Azure or similar

Scripting in python highly desirable

Notions of .NET, C#

Notions HTML4 and web services

As desirable

Experience on UI building is a plus: Qt or similar

Some knowledge of advanced math is a definitive plus

Having worked on Linux and/or microcontrollers is a plus

You will be part of a dynamic high-visibility team working on new product initiatives close with the rest of the team, our colleagues, and... customers around the globe. You will be delivering intuitive and robust applications, easy to use by our customers and making a distinct difference from our competitors.

What Will You Do

Improve current Image quality by adding this technology.

Develop algorithms that could optimize the results.

Image processing and Analysis.

Analysis and verification of the image quality delivered in the products.

Software integration between image processing and press Software

This role might be a good fit if you if you bring:

Knowledge on software in general

Deep knowledge of C/C++ in embedded or ioT environments.

Good understanding of the use of STD in embedded.

Deep knowledge of Concurrency and real time processing

Deep knowledge of Image processing. OpenCV, Google vision, MS computer vision, Azure or similar

Scripting in python highly desirable

Notions of .NET, C#

Notions HTML4 and web services

As desirable

Experience on UI building is a plus: Qt or similar

Some knowledge of advanced math is a definitive plus

Having worked on Linux and/or microcontrollers is a plus

jobs_results.title: Principal Software Engineer Java/Kotlin - Santander Auto Software
jobs_results.description:
Santander Auto Software is looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer

Santander Auto Software, a greenfield program where we are building a brand-new, state of the art global software platform and product suite that will be rolled out in 13 countries.

The business is 100% tech focused, comprised of skilled cross-border software builders, and with a leadership team made up of esteemed individuals with accomplished backgrounds in global tech players.

If you are looking for an opportunity to build creative technology solutions that positively impact hundreds of thousands of international customers, and relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today!

Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of gender identity, culture and disability. Our mission is to contribute to help more people and business prosper.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

We are looking for skilled back end focused software engineers with... experience working with Java (or Kotlin) and Spring Boot, Kubernetes and AWS, who have experience working in a software on demand production environment. You will build Cloud-native, AWS-based, greenfield software and will have time and support to invent solutions to a wide variety of user, business, and technical challenges. We have no cut-and-paste roles and neither will your software be of the cut-and-paste (or integrate and configure) variety. We operate a 'build it and own it' culture, and so you will have a DevOps and individual contributor mindset.

These will be key hires for back-end building squads and help shape this area of the business for scale and be a key member of a fast-growing global team!

EXPERIENCE
• Experience designing, building, scaling and maintaining large scale systems in a multi-tiered, distributed environment.
• Experience in driving high-impact complex problems.
• Exceptional coding skills and demonstrable experience implementing and elevating coding standards across teams.
• Experience with complex organizations with many stakeholders.
• Software development in Java (Spring Boot) or Kotlin - design, build, and deploy
• Production deployment experience working with AWS
• Experience with automated build and test systems for CI/CD (using Docker, Jenkins, etc)
• Experienced in true Agile and its engineering practices with a true DevOps mindset

EDUCATION
• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or another related field. Or equivalent work experience.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE
• Back-end Development with Java or Kotlin.
• Fluent in English.
• Able to deal with ambiguity and change.
• Strong product ownership mindset.
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Must be proficient in asynchronous communication.

LOCATIONS
• The vacancies will be fully remote based out of either the UK, Spain, Portugal or the Netherlands.

If you want to know more about us, follow us on https://www.linkedin.com/company/santander-consumer-finance-global-services/mycompany/

#LI-DNI

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer - C/C+ Developement
jobs_results.description: Join Bequant and develop new innovative tech products Build products of tomorrow Our product is a world leader in its field, and we need the best professionals to solve the most advanced technical problems, because we like to push technology to the limit. You will have the opportunity to work with highly skilled professionals with large experience, to deliver the highest quality software. As a startup, we also offer a very flexible working environment and competitive wages. Application process If interested in one of the following positions and your skills and experience are a match for the role, please send us your CV to ****** Software Engineer - C/C++ Developement Full-time — Madrid, Spain (Hybrid) In this role, you will be part of the core software engineering team and will participate in the design and development of our product. We have a data-plane packet gateway that can now reach 150 Gbps doing very sophisticated processing, and we want to add much more data processing and... reach >1 Tbps Responsibilities Design and develop the core part of our software product. We have a data-plane packet gateway that can now reach 150 Gbps doing very sophisticated processing, and we want to add much more data processing and reach >1 Tbps. Debug and solve possible issues with our software product. Adapt and optimize our software to different hardware and virtual plaforms Minimum Qualifications Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field. 10+ years of software development experience. Expert skills in C and C++ programming and data structures. Experience with IPC and multi-process environments. Deep understanding of the Linux operating system internals/kernel. Experience with scripting in sh/bash and awk. Experience with Linux networking tools (iproute2, tc, iptables, ethtool) Experience with Linux development tools (git, make, gdb, perf, gprof, etc.) Proficient in English (fluent in reading, writing, and speaking). EU nationality or Spanish work permit already granted. Desired Qualifications Experience in network programming with DPDK Experience with virtual environments: KVM, VMware or VirtualBox. Knowledge of network protocols (IP, ICMP, TCP, PPPoE, 802.3ad, etc.) and experience interpreting tcpdump. Experience in Python, Perl and JavaScript programming. Experience in network programming with AF_PACKET/AF_XDP, and with multi-threaded environments. Linux/BSD kernel developing or debugging experience. Familiarity with containers (e.g. Kubernetes) and Linux namespaces. We offer: Full-time indefinite-term employment contract Competitive salary (60K€ - 100K€, depending on experience and qualifications) Work with top-level engineering group in a successful technology start-up#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero de software de telecomunicaciones
jobs_results.description:
⭐Oportunidad Ad Maiorem⭐

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Ingeniero de Software de Telecomunicaciones para que participe en el montaje de una red privada 5G Virtualizada en el ámbito de Defensa. La posición se desarrollará en el noreste de Madrid, y cuenta con importantes beneficios desarrollo profesional

🚀 Funciones:
• Participar en el diseño, desarrollo y despliegue de sistemas de telecomunicaciones basados en la tecnología 5G
• Desarrollar software de alta calidad utilizando C++ para aplicaciones relacionadas con la telecomunicación, como protocolos de red, interfaces de usuario y herramientas de análisis de datos.
• Mantener actualizado sobre las últimas tendencias y avances en tecnología 5G, así como en las mejores prácticas de desarrollo de software, para aplicarlos en el diseño y desarrollo de productos
• Trabajar bajo sistema operativo Linux

🚀 Requisitos:
• Universitario de Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones o afines
• demostrable en el diseño, desarrollo y despliegue... de soluciones de telecomunicaciones, con un enfoque específico en la tecnología 5G.
• en desarrollo con C++
• trabajado bajo sistema operativo Linux
• en virtualización (deseable)
• Openstack (deseable)
• Orquestadores (deseable)
• Networking (deseable)
• SDN (deseable)

🚀 Ofrecemos:
• Oportunidades de capacitación y desarrollo continuo.
• Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y de apoyo.
• Participación en proyectos emocionantes y desafiantes.
• Posibilidad de crecimiento profesional dentro de la organización.
• Modalidad de trabajo híbrido (Madrid)
• Flexibilidad Horaria
• Revisiones salariales anuales
• Compensación Flexible
• 22 días hábiles de vacaciones anuales + Festivos Navidades y Semana Santa

🚀Beneficios de trabajar en AD MAIOREM
• Contrato indefinido
• Compensación flexible
• Modalidad de trabajo híbrida (Noreste de Madrid)

Si eres un graduado apasionado por la tecnología y estás listo para iniciar tu carrera en el diseño de sistemas, ¡te invitamos a ser parte de nuestro equipo!

¡Haz clic en "inscribirme" y forma parte de Ad Maiorem, una compañía internacional donde podrás seguir desarrollando todo tu talento!

CONTACTO

Si te interesa conocer más detalles, envíame tu CV a astrid.arroyo@admaiorem.com y facilítame un número de teléfono y tu disponibilidad horaria para llamarte.

_________________________

¿Por qué Ad Maiorem?

Somos un espacio para desarrollar tus capacidades en los entornos de innovación tecnológica más importantes del mundo. Vemos la tecnología como una oportunidad para vincularnos a nuevas ideas. Generamos un ambiente de confianza que nos permite conocer tus competencias y aportar valor para el éxito de cualquier proyecto tecnológico.

Buscamos profesionales comprometidos con una sólida formación en valores, que deseen sumarse a nuestra cultura de éxito. Nuestra filosofía se resume en una frase: “Tu puerta hacia el futuro”, que significa abrir un horizonte de posibilidades que ayuden a tu crecimiento personal y profesional, llevando tus capacidades al siguiente nivel. Trabajamos por el desarrollo y la innovación, para formar grandes profesionales, forjar líderes e incentivar la creatividad y la participación.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Oportunidades profesionales para desarrollar tu talento y aumentar tu experiencia con impacto internacional. En Ad Maiorem nos basamos en la proyección e innovación tecnológica para consolidar proyectos sostenibles en un entorno de constante cambio. En este sentido, te ofrecemos una línea de carrera con un amplio horizonte de oportunidades para tu crecimiento profesional, ideal para canalizar y dirigir tu experiencia y conocimientos.

¡Te esperamos! 😊
